definitions.explanation: A telephone line connecting to outside the building or organization, as opposed to an internal extension line. In Japanese offices, you typically dial a number (often 0) to access an outside line.

examples.japanese: {外線|がいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧０⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}して→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: To call an outside line, please press 0.

examples.japanese: {外線|がいせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}っている→鳴る：01143_naru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧？
examples.english: The outside line is ringing — can you get it?

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外線|がいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{転送|てんそう}する→転送する：21617_tensousuru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦してある→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During meetings, outside calls are set to be forwarded to reception.

notes:
USAGE:
{外線|がいせん} is standard office vocabulary in Japan. Most business phone systems distinguish between {外線|がいせん} (outside lines) and ⟦{内線|ないせん}→内線：04279_naisen⟧ (internal extensions). Knowing this distinction is essential for working in a Japanese office.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外線|がいせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to make an outside call)
- {外線|がいせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (an outside call comes in)
- {外線|がいせん}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧ (outside line number)
- {外線|がいせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to answer an outside call)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{内線|ないせん}→内線：04279_naisen⟧: internal extension line
- {代表電話|だいひょうでんわ}: main phone number (of a company)
- ⟦{転送|てんそう}→転送：14792_tensou⟧: call forwarding
